target_1800MHz.note: The pinned clv donor already persists MemoryClockSpeed option 0x24 ('1800MHz'); this is a stored request, not an applied clock, and no hardware measurement of MCLK/UCLK/FCLK exists. The historical DF1800 report is associated with a physical feedback modification and a reported SoC above the 1.15 V ceiling, so it is not a reproducible recipe.

target_SoC_1.15V.note: No board-specific measurement establishes 1.15 V as a rating; the field unit/sign/encoding is unresolved and the applied consumer is not located. No repository candidate requests a nonzero VDDCR_VDD/GFX offset.

decisive_missing_tests: Rail-voltage measurement under load on the target board with a known-good baseline image and a verified recovery image.
Independent clock measurement (hardware counter or equivalent) proving applied MCLK/UCLK/FCLK, not displayed values.
A located and traced consumer for $INV record 0x1364 before any voltage request is treated as an applied voltage.
